contexts.text: The travelling companies of Dedanites () = those who are in Knowledges.

A troop cometh () = in the supreme sense, Omnipotence and Omniscience; in the internal sense, the good of faith; in the external, works. For a troop, here, is a multitude; and, when a multitude is predicated of the Lord's Divine, it is an infinite multitude, which is nothing but Omnipotence and Omniscience... That a troop = the good of faith, is from correspondence; for the good of charity corresponds to the Lord's Divine Omnipotence, and the truth of faith to His Omniscience. That a troop = works, is because these correspond to the good of faith; for the good of faith produces works.
A troop shall ravage him () = that works without judgment will drive away from the truth. (Explained.)
I saw two troops from the north, two from the west, and two from the south... There were six troops, or companies.
They divided themselves into little bands.
I saw four troops of Spirits...
Spirits like the troops of an army seen on that way.
I saw walks... and youths who had gathered there in troops, so many companies.
In armies - regiments, battalions, and companies.
The troop spreading itself without () = evil casting out good.
The troop of camels () = all who are in the Knowledges of truth and good. AE 324:9.
